title: Model I · langchain_neo4j.Neo4jGraph
method: Actual Neo4jGraph.query ingestion; cached Qwen3.5 9B extraction from all pages. Adapted schema-controlled extraction replaces LLMGraphTransformer. No source-review additions.

title: Model II · GraphDatabase + ThaiNameTagger
method: Real ThaiNameTagger 1.4 CPU NER and regex. Nearby entities connected as CO_OCCURS_WITH; this is not a factual disease/location relation. Worksheet software dictionary has no relevance to plant PDF and is omitted. Final BIO entity is flushed.

title: Model III · Neo4j_Create plant disease schema
method: New Qwen3.5 9B extraction using crop/disease/pathogen/symptom/treatment schema, all 48 pages; explicit-name validation. GraphDatabase ingestion. No manually added facts.
